MAXIMILIAN: whether a FLAPPING suite should stay red is still his call. check.sh now labels one ('FLAPPING: failed k of n identical reads') but still fails the gate on it, because which conditions are green is a shipped contract. Making it non-fatal is one line in tools/check.sh.

MAXIMILIAN: the worst-of-240-ticks statistic inside tests/citizens, tests/feel and tests/audio is still a single reading per stage. tools/perf.sh now takes a distribution and judges the median; those three suites cannot, because tests/<part>/ belongs to those parts. [D5] has already cut the citizens spike 3.6x, which removes the worst of it.

INTEGRATOR: perf numbers in this report were measured on a shared four-core box with up to four other Godot processes live. tools/perf.sh now warns when that is true. Re-measure alone before quoting any of them.
